result.reason: The clause removes the stated three-year take-or-pay commitment, but permits minimum commitments in signed Order Forms without requiring the fallback protections: limitation to the current 12-month term and reduction on 30 days’ notice. The shortfall-payment mechanism resembles a true-up, but that alone is insufficient. The added suspension and release provisions go beyond what is needed, and “minimum shall credit all amounts paid” is imprecise drafting.
